content: The classification and monitoring of Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) as per the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines involve categorizing albuminuria into three distinct categories based on the urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR): 1. Category A1 (Normal to mildly increased albuminuria): This category is defined by a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio of less than 30 mg/g. 2. Category A2 (Moderately increased albuminuria): This category is characterized by a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio ranging from 30 to 299 mg/g. 3. Category A3 (Severely increased albuminuria): This category is identified by a urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio of 300 mg/g or greater.
